title: Concern / empathy
summary: A quiet change in the lids and mouth, followed by an attentive listening hold.

poses.label: Notice
poses.direction: Open C eyes, small neutral horizontal closed mouth.

poses.label: Concern
poses.direction: Upper lids angle subtly inward to create gentle concern, not angry sharp brows. Small shallow downturned closed mouth. Keep C apertures readable and original eye centres.

poses.label: Stay with you
poses.direction: Lids relax a little but keep concerned attitude, one eye slightly more open. Small almost-flat closed mouth, no grin. Attentive quiet gaze.

cycle: Notice → concern → attentive hold; do not loop a sad reaction during the conversation.
